deadline.value: Priority application deadline is December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027; offers are mostly made for fall.
deadline.quote: The priority application deadline is December 15th, 2026.

gre_subject.value: The department says GRE scores are not required.

supervisor.value: No faculty contact is needed to apply; students choose a group by spring break of year one.
supervisor.quote: You do not need to contact faculty/advisor to apply or be accepted into the program.

funding.value: Students typically serve as graduate teaching assistants, with appointments tied to good standing.
funding.quote: Students will typically serve as a Graduate Teaching Assistant (GTA) for 2-3 sections of a large, undergraduate chemistry or biochemistry class.

entry_route.value: An MS is not needed to apply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: You do not need to hold an MS degree to apply to our PhD programs.

fee_waiver.value: The department cannot waive the application fee for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: our department will not be able to provide an application fee waiver at this time

toefl_min.value: The department requires a total TOEFL of 5 on the new scale, with a speaking score of 5.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: Total 5 or above -internet-based [iBT], the speaking component must be 5 or above

ielts_min.value: The department requires an IELTS overall score of 7.0, with speaking 7.5 to 8.0.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 7.0 with a speaking component of 7.5-8.0

notes: Biochemistry PhD is part of this department's Chemistry and Biochemistry program, so it is not saved as a separate record.
